metaTitle: Custom Sublimation Eye Masks | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom sublimation eye masks in bulk. Vibrant, all-over print with your logo. Perfect for events and giveaways.
introHtml: Sublimation printing allows you to place full-color, all-over designs on custom eye masks with no color limitations or minimum order constraints. This method is ideal for brands that want vibrant, photographic-quality graphics that won't peel or fade after repeated use. Whether you're creating relaxation kits for a corporate wellness program or branded sleep masks for a hotel chain, sublimation ensures your artwork wraps seamlessly around the fabric for a professional finish that stands out from standard screen-printed options.
heroAltText: Custom sublimation eye masks with full-color all-over print featuring a geometric pattern on soft fabric
